plainText:
Princess Salvia (Japanese: サルビア王女 Princess Salvia) is a minor recurring character in . She is a and a Pokémon Coordinator who debuted in Dawn of a Royal Day!.

She is a doppelgänger of , only differing in appearance by her hairstyle, clothing, and voice.

==History==
Princess Salvia was visiting Arrowroot Town as a and was staying at the town's palace along with her and Freesia. Her included a to celebrate diplomatic ties with rulers of other principalities. Although royal obligations have kept Salvia from going on a as a , she always found time to her hoping that one day they would enter a Pokémon Contest. She also kept track of 's journey, watching on television all of the she entered, including the Hearthome City Tag Battle Competition.

When Dawn and arrived in Arrowroot Town, Freesia greeted them and immediately took them to the palace where Salvia was staying. There, Salvia asked Dawn if they could swap identities for the day, which would allow Salvia to enter the Arrowroot Contest. Dawn agreed, and Freesia assisted Dawn in taking on Salvia's royal duties.

Using her Togekiss, Salvia delivered a performance that impressed the judges and secured her a place among the eight contestants moving on to the Battle Stage. Salvia's training paid off as she and Togekiss successfully made their way to the final round, where they faced off against Jessilina and her . After a tough battle, Salvia earned the Arrowroot Ribbon. Out of kindness, she gave the Ribbon to Jessilina rather than keeping it for herself. Salvia later told and that she thoroughly enjoyed the experience. She also gave her Togekiss to Dawn so that it could compete in more Pokémon Contests.

Salvia appeared in a flashback in With the Easiest of Grace! and briefly appeared in A Grand Fight for Winning!, watching the finals of the Sinnoh Grand Festival on television.

==Trivia==
Before the airing of Dawn of a Royal Day!, she was referred to as Princess Iris (アイリス王女) by official sources.
Ash's next female traveling companion after Dawn would coincidentally also be named Iris.
In the English dub, she speaks with a slight British accent.
